description: A solid brick-and-stone three-unit investment building in the heart of Logan Square, with all units currently rented. The big-ticket items are done: a built-up rubber roof with a recent silver coating, energy-efficient windows, a new high-efficiency boiler (2024), updated 200-amp electrical (2021), mini-split systems, and kitchens rehabbed in 2020, plus a two-car garage. Steps from the California Blue Line, Palmer Square Park, and quick I-90/94 access. A turnkey income property for an investor who wants cash flow in one of the city's most in-demand neighborhoods.

A bright, move-in-ready townhouse in the sought-after Greenwood Place subdivision, served by Districts 25 and 214. Three bedrooms, three full and one half bath, a finished basement, stainless appliances, a fireplace, and a private deck. Updated HVAC, roof, and appliances, with a classic brick-and-cedar exterior, all close to parks, schools, and shopping. Currently under contract.

A spacious four-bedroom home on a beautiful three-quarter-acre lot in Prairie View. Updated mechanicals throughout (plumbing and service lines, furnace, roof, and A/C), a three-car detached garage plus a shed, an above-ground pool, and a large, private backyard. Sold in May 2026.

A classic Logan Square two-unit, built in 1901 and full of vintage character, on a quiet residential block near the neighborhood's parks and dining. A great owner-occupant or investment opportunity. Sold in October 2025.

A well-kept split-level on a quiet cul-de-sac, with an eat-in kitchen and stainless appliances, a separate dining room, a primary bedroom with walk-in closet, a full basement, and a spacious backyard with a concrete patio. Two-car attached garage. Sold in 2024.

A two-story home in Roselle's Seasons 4 community, with a low monthly HOA that includes the pool and clubhouse. Stainless kitchen, first-floor laundry, a primary suite with walk-in closet and full bath, an open living and dining area, and a family room with fireplace. Two-car attached garage, with A/C updated in 2020. Sold in 2024.
